scripts.test:e2e: turbo run build || exit 1; echo '[E2E] Starting API server...'; sh -c "export GRPC_JWT_SECRET=\"${GRPC_JWT_SECRET:-test-secret-key-32-characters-long-for-testing-only-do-not-use-production}\"; export GRPC_API_HOST=\"${GRPC_API_HOST:-localhost:50051}\"; export GRPC_API_SECURE=\"${GRPC_API_SECURE:-false}\"; pnpm --filter api start" & API_PID=$!; echo '[E2E] Waiting for API health check (up to 30s)...'; for i in {0..60}; do if curl -sf http://localhost:3001/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[E2E] API ready!'; break; fi; if [ $i -eq 60 ]; then echo '[E2E] FATAL: API health check timeout'; kill $API_PID 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; sleep 0.5; done; echo '[E2E] Running playwright tests...'; turbo run test:e2e; EXIT=$?; echo '[E2E] Cleaning up...'; kill $API_PID 2>/dev/null; exit $EXIT
